subject: FinHealth Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: FinHealth Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Regulated workloads (HIPAA) require data residency and strict audit trails.
- Existing vendor latency variability when processing EHR-derived prompts; impacting user experience.
- Procurement requires vendor-hosted Private/VPC option rather than shared hosted endpoints.

Current stack you described:
- Core apps in AWS us-east-1 using a VPC per environment.
- KMS: AWS KMS for customer-managed keys (CMKs) with strict rotation policies.
- Network: heavy use of private subnets and an internal bastion host; limited outbound egress from production subnets.

Success criteria for a pilot (your priorities):
1) Data never leaves the FinHealth VPC (or is encrypted with customer-managed keys).
2) Latency under 200ms p50 for the conversational workflow.
3) Audit logs and token-level request tracing available for SOC/Compliance review.

Constraints and risks we captured:
- Air-gapped or strictly isolated environments may require an on-prem bundle and offline install support.
- Procurement will require SOC2 evidence and a network diagram demonstrating connectivity flows.

Proposed next steps (owners & timeline):
- Marissa: send SOC2 questionnaire and Redwood Private deployment checklist by EOD today (ACTION: marissa.cole).
- FinHealth: share a redacted network diagram and list of IPs/subnets we’d need to allow (ACTION: Alex/Priya) — target by Oct 23.
- Dylan: schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra engineer (30–45m) for Oct 27 — calendar invite to follow.

Attachments: SOC2_questionnaire.pdf (draft), deployment-checklist.docx (link to Drive).

If I missed anything or you want to re-prioritize the success criteria, let me know. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the items above.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>

Subject: Re: FinHealth Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Thanks Dylan — this is great and matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:
- We do need either an in-VPC deployment or a private endpoint with no persistence of PHI outside our KMS boundaries.
- CMK policy: we require that keys are customer-controlled in AWS KMS; we cannot hand over key material.
- For the pilot scope, we care more about throughput during batch ingestion (end-of-day processing) than small chat bursts — so please include perf numbers for batch workloads as well.

We’ll aim to share the redacted network diagram by Friday (Oct 23). Also, procurement asked whether Redwood supports HSM-backed keys — can you confirm?

Alex
Head of Infrastructure, FinHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinHealth Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Alex — thanks for the clarifications. Quick responses below and a couple of asks.

1) Customer-managed KMS: Yes — Redwood Private supports bring-your-own-keys via AWS KMS CMKs. We do not hold key material; Redwood services call KMS within the customer account. We also offer integrations with Vault and HSM providers for Private/on-prem installations.

2) HSM support: For Private/on-prem we can integrate with HSM-backed key stores (YubiHSM/CloudHSM) — we’ll include the integration notes in the questionnaire. For hosted Dedicated we support CloudHSM where the customer provisions the HSM and we call into it per the approved architecture.

3) Batch perf: We'll include batch throughput numbers and a short note on our recommended autoscaling and queueing patterns for end-of-day jobs.

Action items I’m attaching: SOC2_questionnaire.pdf (filled sections), and a Redwood Private deployment checklist. Alex/Priya — could you attach the network diagram to this thread and indicate whether you require outbound-only connectivity or fully air-gapped (no outbound)? That will determine whether we propose an on-prem installer or a VPC-resident Private deployment.

Planned owners/timelines (confirming Dylan’s bullets):
- Marissa: SOC2 + deployment checklist (sent) — ACTION: marissa.cole — complete.
- FinHealth: redacted network diagram + egress policy — ACTION: alex.johnson/priya.rao — due Oct 23.
- Dylan: schedule tech deep-dive with infra engineer — ACTION: dylan.brooks — invite to follow.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the SOC2 responses if your procurement wants that.

Best,
Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_questionnaire.pdf, redacted-deployment-checklist.pdf
